source_outcome: operator terminated the first paid comparison during Docker setup
mechanism: RunInstances encoded an already encoded script. The operator treated the read-back mismatch as proof of startup failure. The later host log showed a running bootstrap, an armed deadline timer, and a verified package. Termination interrupted Docker setup.
summary: The first FERAL comparison ended after the operator mistook extra user-data encoding for proof that startup had failed; the host had already verified the package and armed its timer.
lineage_note: Pass plain script text to the AWS CLI. Test the real request bytes. Read the host log before drawing a startup conclusion from a transport mismatch, and preserve the original deadline.
